lines.en: I walk slowly through the birch wood.

lines.zh: 一队同伴跟着我穿过树影。
lines.en: My pack follows me through the trees.
I cross the fallen leaves without a sound.
I move along the treeline.
I keep low, hugging the brush.
I stop and sniff with each step.

lines.zh: 我从花森林的边上过去。
lines.en: I pass the edge of the flower forest.
I cross the conifer wood slowly.
Four or five others are with me.
I turn toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我从两根白桦之间侧身穿过。
lines.en: I slip sideways between two birches.

lines.zh: 我踩过霜草，鼻息结成白雾。
lines.en: I pad over frosted grass, breath turning to fog.

lines.zh: 我伏在树影里，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie in the tree shadow, still.

lines.zh: 我卧在苔藓上，耳朵一直在转。
lines.en: I lie on the moss, ears swiveling without rest.

lines.zh: 我抬头，鼻尖对着风来的方向。
lines.en: I lift my head, nose toward the wind.
My pack circles nearby.
I sink my body lower.
The wood is very quiet.
I lick my paw.

lines.zh: 左边有枯枝断了一下，我听见了。
lines.en: A twig snapped on the left; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我等着，不发出一点声音。
lines.en: I wait without a sound.
The dark is my cover.
I open my jaws and make no sound.
The wind comes from the dark forest.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收到腿间，卧下来。
lines.en: I tuck my tail between my legs and lie down.
Leaves rustle far off.
I lie low and make the moment last.

lines.zh: 我的毛在月光下也不反光。
lines.en: Even in moonlight my fur doesn't shine.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一段树桩。
lines.en: I stay still as a stump.

lines.zh: 白桦影里，我把尾巴收起来。
lines.en: In the birch shade, I tuck my tail in.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道很新鲜，白桦林里少见。
lines.en: Your scent is fresh, rare in the birches.
I lean out from behind a tree.
I take two slow steps toward you.

lines.zh: 我站在你影子上，你没有发觉。
lines.en: I stand on your shadow, and you don't notice.

lines.zh: 我的同伴已经绕到你后面。
lines.en: My pack is already behind you.
I don't bark; I only watch.

lines.zh: 你站在这片林子里太久了。
lines.en: You've stood in this wood too long.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子告诉我你很紧张。
lines.en: My nose tells me you're tense.
I lower my forequarters, ready.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的爪子就进一步。
lines.en: You step back; I step forward.

lines.zh: 我身后传来同伴的爪子声。
lines.en: My packmates' claws sound behind me.
I tilt my head a little at you.

lines.zh: 白桦林里一群，暗狼的皮很厚。
lines.en: A pack in the birches, with thick dark hides.

lines.zh: 你背后是黑森林，我堵在前面。
lines.en: The dark forest is behind you, and I block the front.
I circle round quietly.

lines.zh: 暗狼皮破了一道，我夹起尾巴。
lines.en: My dark pelt splits open, and I tuck my tail.
A cut has opened in my fur.
I circle behind a tree and crouch.
My pack closes in to shield me.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔伤口，继续盯着你。
lines.en: I lick the wound and keep watching you.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩毛，血点溅在落叶上。
lines.en: I shake my coat, blood spotting the fallen leaves.
My teeth are still bared.
Your scent, I have noted it.
I ease half a step into shadow.
I won't just walk away.
There's meat in that smell.
I approach slowly, wary.
Set it on the ground first.
I sniff it, then back off.
My pack has gathered round.
I eat first; they wait.
This isn't enough to share.
I take it and move off a little.
I remember that you gave something.
I won't thank you, but I'll leave.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞上一段黑。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a patch of black.
Two to five of us run together.
Dark wolf hide on my back.

lines.zh: 你踩乱了我的尾毛，我甩了甩。
lines.en: You step on my tail fur, and I shake it out.
I growl low and pull back.
Don't press against me; I don't like it.
My pack has closed in too.

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧了一步，又站稳。
lines.en: The hit knocks me a step sideways, and I steady myself.
I ease half a step into shadow.
There's no open ground in this wood.

lines.zh: 另一只暗色的影子靠近。
lines.en: Another dark shape comes near.

lines.zh: 我们一群游荡，白桦林是我们的。
lines.en: We roam in packs; the birch wood is ours.
Her eyes shine too.

lines.zh: 这窝幼崽会藏在树根下。
lines.en: The pups will be hidden under roots.

lines.zh: 我们一起巡过这片林子。
lines.en: We patrol this wood together.
I growl low and she answers.

lines.zh: 我们并肩走了很长一段。
lines.en: We walk a long way side by side.

lines.zh: 月光把我们的影子连起来。
lines.en: Moonlight joins our shadows.

lines.zh: 树林里只有我们的脚步。
lines.en: Only our steps sound in the wood.
We'll part before dawn.

lines.zh: 我咬住那东西，拖进灌木里。
lines.en: I bite it and drag it into the bushes.
I bury it in the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，扭头吐了口气。
lines.en: I sniff it and turn away with a huff.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱了拱，那东西不动。
lines.en: I nudge it with my nose; it does not move.
I carry it to my pack.
This isn't enough to share.
I pin it under a paw.
I sniff it a long while first.
It carries a faint smell of blood.
I carry it into the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 白桦林里的影子一晃，我压低身。
lines.en: A shadow shifts among the birches, and I crouch.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我的皮比夜还暗。
lines.en: In the dark forest my hide is darker than night.
I crouch low, ready.
My pack has spread to surround.
It can't leave this wood.
I press slowly toward it.
That one is alone.

lines.zh: 我踏碎一根枯枝，朝那个方向走。
lines.en: I snap a dead twig and head that way.

lines.zh: 我绕到下风口，让它闻不到我。
lines.en: I circle downwind so it cannot smell me.
It's inside my ring.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，暗狼的足迹跟着你。
lines.en: In the birch woods, dark wolf tracks follow you.
It runs; my pack spreads and follows.
I wait behind a tree for it to pass.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，一寸一寸挪近。
lines.en: I lower myself and inch closer.
I hear its breathing.
Changing angle; I come from the side.
It has backed into dense trees.
In dense wood we have the advantage.
My coat is black as if burned.

lines.zh: 我带着一队同伴穿过白桦树影。
lines.en: I lead a pack through the birch shadows.
I can almost smell its sweat.
I'm ready to spring.
Dark wolf teeth clamp and stay.
I slam in from the side.
My teeth go deep.
My pack lunges from the other side.
It's dragged down onto the leaves.
I wrench my head and tear.

lines.zh: 这点血味让我们更兴奋。
lines.en: The blood smell sharpens us.
I pin its shoulder.
Only panting sounds in the wood.
I pull back and let my pack in.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的阴影里走出。
lines.en: I walk out of the dark forest's shadow.
Something stirs under the leaf litter.
A dark wolf, at the treeline.

lines.zh: 树影里先亮起两点黄，然后是我。
lines.en: Two yellow points light the trees, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 我从树后出来，身后还有四双眼睛。
lines.en: I come out from the trees with four more pairs of eyes behind me.

lines.zh: 白桦林里多了几个影子。
lines.en: New shadows in the birch wood.
I raise my head and taste the wind.
The wood's scent has changed.
I step out between the conifers.
My fur is deeper than the night.
We spread into a half circle.
I don't howl; this is quieter.

lines.zh: 我从花森林的边缘绕进来。
lines.en: I slip in at the flower forest's edge.
Steps come from deep in the wood.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的毛，焦味刺鼻。
lines.en: Fire sears my fur with a sharp stink.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，摔进落叶里。
lines.en: I tumble down a slope into the leaves.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我挣不开。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I can't break free.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，肚皮朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me onto my back.
An arrow lodges in my flank.

lines.zh: 那股怪力钻进我的骨头里。
lines.en: Strange force creeps into my bones.

lines.zh: 饿得我连低吼都没力气。
lines.en: Too hungry even to growl.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我的毛全竖起来了。
lines.en: At the thunder, my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 这里没有树，也没有地面。
lines.en: No trees here, and no ground.
